relation_occurrence_universe.unit: admitted directed relation occurrence retaining multiplicity and explicit weight
relation_occurrence_universe.denominator: count of all admitted relation occurrences under the bound projection
relation_occurrence_universe.duplicate_accounting: each admitted relation occurrence contributes exactly once

conductance.name: weighted directed cut conductance
conductance.numerator: sum of explicit weights of crossing occurrences incident to the community
conductance.denominator: minimum of total admitted weighted out-volume of the community and its complement

high_centrality_crossing_nodes.denominator: all admitted nodes with an available bound centrality value
high_centrality_crossing_nodes.classification: node has at least one admitted crossing occurrence

bridges_and_articulation_points.bridge_definition: removal of the identified projected edge increases weakly connected component count
bridges_and_articulation_points.articulation_definition: removal of the identified projected node increases weakly connected component count
bridges_and_articulation_points.parallel_occurrence_policy: occurrence multiplicity is retained and parallel occurrences prevent a unique edge occurrence from being a bridge

outcome_accounting.EMPTY: computation completed over a non-missing admitted universe and yielded zero members; denominators remain reported
outcome_accounting.INCOMPLETE: some admitted item could not be accounted for; missing count and witnessed item identities are required and publication is blocked
outcome_accounting.UNAVAILABLE: the named measure is undefined or its required input is unavailable; reason and affected denominator are required

claim_ceiling.text: All measures and witnesses are structural observations under the exact bound projection. They do not establish feature, product, ownership, service, organizational, or business-boundary identity or explanation.
